description: This Java source file defines the Android activity class ReceiveResult, which demonstrates how to launch another activity for a result and handle the returned data. It manages UI elements such as a TextView and a Button, and overrides lifecycle methods including onCreate() and onActivityResult().

classes.name: ReceiveResult
classes.description: An Android activity that launches another activity expecting a result and displays the outcome, illustrating inter-activity communication via startActivityForResult and onActivityResult.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the UI layout, and prepares the TextView and Button for user interaction.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result returned from the launched activity, updating the TextView with the outcome or cancellation message.
